title: Myths to correct
objectives: Correct seven IDCW myths with the reality behind each.
Explain why “monthly IDCW means fixed income” is false.
body_md:
“IDCW is extra income on top of my investment.” Reality: it is part of your own investment paid back; the NAV falls by the same amount. “A fund that pays IDCW is a better fund.” Reality: payouts say nothing about performance; growth and IDCW options hold the same portfolio. “IDCW is tax-free.” Reality: that was the old rule; since April 2020, IDCW is taxed at your slab rate, with TDS above the threshold. “Monthly IDCW means a fixed monthly income.” Reality: amount and frequency aren't guaranteed; payouts can be cut or skipped. “IDCW reinvestment is the same as growth.” Reality: same value before tax, but you pay tax on every reinvested payout. “Buy before the record date to earn the IDCW.” Reality: the NAV falls by the payout, and you pay tax on it — you end up worse off. “A high IDCW rate per unit means a high return.” Reality: the rate is per unit, not a percentage of your investment, and it reduces the NAV.

| Myth | Reality |
| --- | --- |
| "IDCW is extra income on top of my investment." | It is part of your own investment paid back; the NAV falls by the same amount. |
| "A fund that pays IDCW is a better fund." | Payouts say nothing about performance; growth and IDCW options hold the same portfolio. |
| "IDCW is tax-free." | That was the old rule. Since April 2020, IDCW is taxed at your slab rate, with TDS above the threshold. |
| "Monthly IDCW means a fixed monthly income." | Amount and frequency aren't guaranteed; payouts can be cut or skipped. |
| "IDCW reinvestment is the same as growth." | Same value before tax, but you pay tax on every reinvested payout. |
| "Buy before the record date to earn the IDCW." | The NAV falls by the payout, and you pay tax on it: you end up worse off. |
| "A high IDCW rate per unit means a high return." | The rate is per unit, not a percentage of your investment, and it reduces the NAV. |
example: Monthly IDCW cut this month? That does not by itself mean the fund is in trouble — payouts depend on surplus and trustee decisions.
say: Don't judge a fund by its payouts; judge it by total return, after tax.
never: A fund paying IDCW is a better fund.

check.q: “A high IDCW rate per unit means a high return” is wrong because:
o: The rate is per unit, not a percentage of your investment, and it reduces the NAV
check.why: The rate is per unit, not a percentage of your investment, and it reduces the NAV.

check.q: “Monthly IDCW means fixed monthly income” is wrong because:
o: IDCW is paid by the AMC's profits
Amount and frequency aren't guaranteed; payouts can be cut or skipped
check.why: Amount and frequency aren't guaranteed; payouts can be cut or skipped.

check.q: Which myth does “IDCW is tax-free” reflect?
o: The pre-2020 rule: since April 2020 IDCW is taxed at slab rate
check.why: That was the old rule. Since April 2020, IDCW is taxed at your slab rate, with TDS above the threshold.
